Welcome to the official website of Yala Safari Camping…

Managed by us , as a team of youths who were grown up with wild life and nature since childhood and our life time love and experience continuously transformed to satisfy the taste of wild life and nature lovers of all over the world. We come to the present level of being one of the best camping and safari experience in Sri Lanka from the satisfaction of our beloved guests for the last decade since our humble beginning.
Most of the travelers have made repeat guest of us because of the exceptional care that is taken for each guest during their stay. The experience with us will definitely transform for a lifetime of memories

Things you can do
Yala national park is one of the best destinations for bird watching. The area is  home to the most number of endemic bird species in the island as well as  a popular destination for hundreds of migrant bird species as well.
Yala national park most probably has the densest leopard population in the entire world. Catching a glimpse of  this majestic creature in its natural habitat is not going to be that hard.
Sri Lanka is well known for it s elephants. The Yala national park is the home for nearly four hundred wild elephants. You will never miss a sighting of this amazing  animal roaming in the wilderness in large numbers.

pages.text:
About Us | Yala Safari Camping in Sri Lanka
Skip to content
Best camping
experience
Our team, comprised of passionate wildlife and nature enthusiasts, has been part of Yala Safari Camping since its inception. Growing up in the vicinity of Yala National Park, we developed a deep connection with jungle wildlife. In 2003, we established our first campsite, and since then, our commitment to excellence has earned us a reputation as one of South Asia’s premier safari camping providers.
Unique location
Our campsite occupies an exceptional location—the very best in the area. Nestled deep within the wilderness, it rests atop a small cliff, granting an unobstructed panorama spanning all five blocks of Yala National Park, extending all the way to the ocean. The absence of human activity in the immediate vicinity ensures an authentic wildlife experience for our cherished guests.
Deep into the wilderness
Nestled among the wilderness, our campsite stands as one of the most remote and adventurous in the region. Our campsite combines the thrill of the wild with the comforts of a luxury hotel. It’s a haven protected from wildlife and mosquitoes.
Breathtaking views
Perched atop a rugged cliff, our open deck restaurant offers an awe-inspiring panorama—the finest in the entire region. As you dine, your eyes will feast upon the vast wilderness of magnificent Yala National Park.
Eco friendly approach
At Sri Lanka Yala Safari, we prioritize sustainability. Our campsite seamlessly blends with the natural environment, utilizing solar power for energy needs. Palmyra leaf roofing provides insulation, keeping temperatures comfortable year-round. We minimize our footprint, encourage responsible waste management, and share educational insights on conservation. Together, we create a greener future.
